battle.name: 唐收復洛陽之戰
battle.brief: 至德二載（757）九月，郭子儀、李光弼率朔方、河中之師與史思明精騎戰於洛陽城北洛水之北、邙山南麓，唐軍大破叛軍，東都一度重歸朝廷。卡面那具羅馬重步兵並未入華，它代表的是以盾列與輪替守住陣線的辦法。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是重建於靈武的唐廷與安史叛軍建立的偽燕。唐廷一方以朔方軍為骨幹：郭子儀以中軍節度使、天下兵馬副元帥的身份統朔方與河中之兵，李光弼以河東節度使統河東精兵，另有西京行營與禁軍一部，兵馬分屬多道而號令歸於行軍總制；監軍由宦官魚朝恩以觀軍容使的身份居中提監視之權，使朝廷能直接駕馭外軍。河中、河東兩鎮的降附兵、河南郡縣的團練，以及安史舊部中倒戈的將校，都被編入唐軍序列，這支部隊的來源與成分比安史亂前任何一支唐軍都更雜。叛軍一方此時以史思明為主帥，安慶緒退保鄴城，偽燕的兵骨幹仍是河北各鎮：范陽、平盧、成德等節度使名下以契丹、奚、室韋騎兵為主力，雜以河北州縣的團練鄉兵與關中淪陷後散在軍中的市卒游騎。史思明自報領十三郡、兵八萬，兵多而編制鬆散，各節度使擁兵自重、彼此不通聲氣，是這支部隊的結構性弱點。整體看，唐廷是號令統一而兵源多路的聯軍，叛軍則是河北老底子加散兵游騎的鬆散聯盟。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Tang court, rebuilt at Lingwu, and the rebel state of Yan founded by An Lushan and continued by An Qingxu. On the Tang side the backbone was the Northern Circuit: Guo Ziyi, holding the posts of commander of the central army and deputy commander-in-chief of all the imperial forces, led the troops of the Northern and Central Circuits, Li Guangbi as jiedushi of Hedong led the picked soldiers of Hedong, and there were in addition the forces of the Western Capital field headquarters and a part of the imperial guards. The troops were drawn from many circuits but hung together under the single authority of the field command, while the eunuch Yu Chao'en, who held the office of supervisor of the army's appearance, sat in the middle of it with the right of inspection, so that the court could hold the field army directly. Troops surrendered from Hezhong and Hedong, the militia of the Henan prefectures and commanders who had turned coat from the old rebel forces were all folded into the Tang order of battle; the origins and composition of this army were more mixed than those of any Tang force raised before the rebellion. On the rebel side the field command belonged now to Shi Siming, while An Qingxu had fallen back on Yecheng; the skeleton of the Yan army was still the circuits of Hebei: under the jiedushi of Fanyang, Pinglu, Chengde and their peers, Khitan, Xi and Shiwei cavalry formed the main body, mixed in with the local militia of the Hebei prefectures and with the town soldiers and free riders who had scattered in the army after the fall of Guanzhong. Shi Siming claimed for himself thirteen prefectures and eighty thousand men; the numbers were large but the organisation loose, for each jiedushi held his own troops and none of them could be got to act in concert with the others, and that was the structural weakness of the rebel host. In sum, the Tang side was a coalition with a single chain of command but many sources of men, and the rebels a loose alliance of Hebei's old military households and scattered bands of stragglers.
people: 主導本役的是郭子儀與李光弼。郭子儀在安史亂後收拾河中、整合朔方舊部，以穩健見長，靠個人威望統一各道兵馬，是唐軍能持續壓進的前提；李光弼則以治軍嚴整、臨陣沉著著名，本役中唐軍一度被叛軍騎兵衝得陣腳動搖，正是他遣精騎出陣反擊，才把戰局扳回。宦官魚朝恩以觀軍容使隨軍，權責介於統帥與監軍之間，是唐廷派系伸手到軍中的所在。叛軍主帥史思明，本名窣干，出身昭武九姓的粟特人，祖居營州柳城，天寶年間由玄宗改名，與安祿山同鄉，驍勇而多詐，早年受安祿山提拔為平盧大將，潼關之敗後統范陽十三郡，是河北最能打的悍將。宰相張鎔看出史思明歸降有詐，屢請朝廷勿信；肅宗不聽，遣烏承恩赴幽州犒軍兼加監視，烏承恩擅自策反其部下，半年之後反被史思明所殺，叛旗重豎。安慶緒坐鎮鄴城，曾圖除掉史思明而派阿史那承慶、安守忠謀事，事敗之後這二人反被史思明囚禁。仆固懷恩引回鶻精騎參與唐廷在關中與河東的戰事，本役唐軍已無回鶻大隊在側，但盟軍式的協作與酬賞慣例在此後的戰役中延續。
peopleEn: The men who shaped this operation were Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi. Guo Ziyi, who took stock of Hezhong after the rebellion and welded the old units of the Northern Circuit together, was known for steadiness, and his personal standing was what held the troops of the several circuits together; without it the Tang could not have kept pressing forward. Li Guangbi was known for the strictness of his camp and his composure in action, and when the Tang line was shaken in this battle by the rebel horse it was his sending of picked cavalry out of the line that turned the action back. The eunuch Yu Chao'en accompanied the army as supervisor of its appearance, standing between commander and overseer, and he was the point at which the court's factions reached into the army. The rebel commander Shi Siming was born Suogan, of Sogdian descent from the nine surnames of Zhao'an, his family long settled at Liucheng in Yingzhou; the emperor Xuanzong gave him the name Siming, and he was a fellow townsman of An Lushan, brave, wily and practised at command. Raised by An Lushan to be the great general of Pinglu, he had held Fanyang and its thirteen prefectures since the defeat at Tong Pass, and he was the ablest hostile commander in Hebei. The chancellor Zhang Rong saw through the surrender as a sham and petitioned the court not to believe it; Suzong would not listen and instead sent Wu Cheng'en to Youzhou with gifts and instructions to watch Shi Siming. Wu Cheng'en went further and tried to suborn the rebel's own officers, and six months later Shi Siming killed him and raised his banner again. An Qingxu sat at Yecheng and had tried to remove Shi Siming by setting Ashina Chengqing and An Shouzhong to work; the attempt failed, and those two were seized and locked up by Shi Siming instead. Pugu Huai'en had led the picked Uyghur cavalry in the Tang campaigns in Guanzhong and Hedong; the main body of the Uyghur horse was no longer present at Luoyang, but the way the allies had fought together and the custom of paying them off carried on into the campaigns that followed.
kits: 卡面那具羅馬重步兵，約公元前一百年前後成型：分段鎧甲（segmentata）配大盾（scutum），左肩重盾護住身體，右側掛短劍，手中是投槍（pilum），配以百人為單位的軍團編制與嚴格的營地秩序。這套裝備的關鍵不在鐵，而在隊形與補給：羅馬靠的是兵源補充與糧道暢通，而不是靠重裝硬扛，它面對高盧、日耳曼各族的蠻族騎兵，靠密集縱隊與輪替頂替，把衝鋒化為消耗。同一套邏輯在唐軍身上同樣讀得到，只是物質不同：唐軍步卒用陌刀——雙刃、刀身修長逾丈半，長柄護手，作軍隊集體突擊的長刀；騎兵佩橫刀，單刃便於抽擊；步卒以方盾、圓盾成列抵擋，以長槊與戈補長距。護具以明光鎧為代表，胸前一片圓盤護胸，重在護住胸腹而非全身，鎧外披甲，內綴袍服，長槊手多著皮甲、札甲，禁軍精騎才用鎖子甲配長槊。遠射靠蹶張弩、單弓與角弓，箭鏃以鐵為主。叛軍精騎是另一套體系：契丹、奚、室韋騎兵慣用小型複合弓，善於騎射與迂迴包抄，不靠正面硬撞，而靠散開、掠射、再聚合。攻城器械方面，雙方都備雲梯、撞車、擲石機與巢車，但本役的勝負落在野外的騎步對決上，攻城器械幾乎沒有派上用場。真正的關鍵在後勤：唐軍的糧秣由河中、河東沿黃河與洛水轉運，叛軍則靠河北十三郡就地取給，兩條補給線的長短，直接決定了洛陽城下一場會戰能撐多久。
kitsEn: The figure on the card is the Roman legionary as it looked around a century before the beginning of the Common Era: banded segmentata armour over a large scutum carried on the left arm, a short sword at the right side, a javelin, the pilum, in the hand, organised in centuries and housed in a camp of strict order. The point of that equipment lay not in the iron but in the formation and the supply: Rome relied on the renewal of its manpower and on open lines of supply rather than on weight of armour, and against the massed horse of the Gauls, Germans and the other steppe peoples it met the charge with close-packed ranks and reliefs, turning an assault into a grind of attrition. The same logic can be read in the Tang army, though the materials differ: the Tang foot soldier carried the modao, a double-edged blade more than a metre and a half long with a long hilt and a hand-guard, used as the collective long-sword of an assault; the cavalry carried the hengdao, single-edged and quick to draw; the infantry stood in files of square and round shields, with the long spear and the ge covering the longer reaches. Their armour was represented by the Mingguang piece, with a round disc at the chest covering the torso, concerned above all with the chest and belly rather than the whole body, a coat worn over it and garments within; the spearmen mostly in leather or lamellar plate, while only the picked cavalry of the imperial guards carried mail together with the long spear. At range the army used the strong-drawn crossbow, the single bow and the composite bow, with iron heads. The rebel horse was a different system: Khitan, Xi and Shiwei riders used small composite bows and were skilled at shooting from the saddle and at turning the flank, relying on dispersal, shooting at an angle and re-forming rather than on a head-on impact. On siege work both sides kept scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers and nest-towers, but in this operation the decision was made in the open field between horse and foot, and the siege train was scarcely used at all. What mattered most was logistics: the Tang drew grain from Hezhong and Hedong along the Yellow River and the Luo, while the rebels took theirs in place from the thirteen prefectures of Hebei, and the length of those two lines of supply decided how long a contest before Luoyang could be sustained.
tactics: 本役的戰術主軸是「以步制騎」與「斷糧困城」兩段。九月，唐軍進至洛陽城北，選擇洛水之北、邙山南麓一線布陣：正面以步兵列盾為牆，步卒以陌刀與長槊迎擊衝鋒，兩翼與側後置騎兵，等叛軍精騎反覆衝擊而後以騎兵出擊分割。史思明傾巢出動，把精騎集中在唐軍正面，試圖一衝即破。叛軍騎兵確實一度突破唐軍前陣，陣腳鬆動，步卒死力支撐才沒有當場崩潰；李光弼見狀遣精騎出陣反擊，騎兵在正面與側翼同時發力，叛軍的衝鋒隊形被切開，潰勢再也收不住。追擊一路奔向河道，溺斃與被殺者甚多，屍骸堆塞水道，血水混入洛水。此後唐軍不再急於強攻城垣，而是在洛陽城北與城西分築堡壘，環城而居，斷絕叛軍的水陸糧道與漕運，把攻城戰改成飢餓戰：叛軍城內存糧有限，士卒飢疲，軍心一日比一日難維繫；史思明一面收攏散卒重整隊伍，一面遣使向唐廷求和。整體看，這是一場典型的唐廷式打法：先以步騎配合的正面會戰打掉敵人主力，再以圍城與斷糧收其城，勝在兩步之間銜接得快，敗在圍城階段未能再決戰一次。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this operation had two parts: using the foot to hold the horse, and then starving the city. In the ninth month the Tang army came up to the north of Luoyang and took its line on the north bank of the Luo at the southern foot of Mangshan: the front was a wall of shields, the foot soldiers meeting the charge with modao blades and long spears, with cavalry on the flanks and behind the line waiting for the rebel horse to charge again and again and then striking out to cut them up. Shi Siming brought out everything he had, concentrating his picked horse against the Tang front in the hope of breaking it in a single rush. The rebel horse did indeed pierce the forward line and the formation wavered, and only the infantry holding on at the limit kept the line from coming apart there and then; Li Guangbi, seeing it, sent picked cavalry out of the line to counter-attack, and the Tang horse struck at the front and on the flank at once, the rebel charge was cut open and the rout could no longer be arrested. The pursuit ran down to the water, where the drowned and the slain were many and the corpses clogged the channel, the blood of the field mixing with the waters of the Luo. After that the Tang no longer hurried to storm the walls; they raised stockades to the north and west of the city, sat down in a ring around it and cut the rebels' road and water supply, turning a siege into a war of hunger, for the grain inside the city was limited, the men were hungry and tired, and the morale of the garrison grew harder to hold with every day. Shi Siming gathered up his broken men and reformed them as best he could, and sent envoys to ask for peace. In sum this was the classic Tang formula: a frontal meeting engagement of foot and horse to break the enemy's main force, and then a blockade and a strangle of the grain to take the city; it was won by the quick junction of the two steps, and lost in the blockade phase, which never produced a second decisive battle.
data: 可核的數字大致如下。時間上，洛陽自755年十二月陷落，到本役在757年九月開打，前後約二十個月，是安史之亂中洛陽淪陷最長的一段。叛軍方面，《資治通鑑》記史思明「悉衆精騎」出戰，另有一說記精騎約五萬；史思明降唐時自報領十三郡、兵八萬，這個數字出自敵方自述，與到陣之數未必相符。唐軍方面，郭子儀、李光弼分統朔方、河中、河東之兵，加禁軍與降附部隊，總數各書記載不一，或稱十餘萬、或稱數萬，較穩妥的看法是這是一支以精兵為核心、雜兵為輔的聯軍，不宜把兵額直接換算成戰力。戰果方面，斬首數萬級，溺死及奔散者不可勝計，屍骸堆塞河道；數字出自史官轉述，諸書所載略有出入，應視為量級而非精確值。距離上，唐軍主力由河陽（孟津）方向南下，距洛陽約百餘里；戰場在洛陽城北數里至十餘里之間，叛軍攻城器械與騎兵的調度都要依賴這段距離。消耗方面，洛陽城內府庫兵械在兩年戰亂中多為叛軍所掠，唐軍入城之後軍器不足，須自河中、河東調發，糧秣則依賴黃河漕運與洛水轉運。往後看，758年史思明率河北兵再取洛陽，761年史思明被其子史朝義所弒，安史之亂到763年才完全平定——這三個年份說明，本役的勝利沒有能單獨改變戰局。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. In time: Luoyang fell in the twelfth month of 755 and the fighting in front of it began in the ninth month of 757, a matter of about twenty months, the longest single stretch that Luoyang spent in rebel hands during the rebellion. On the rebel side the Zizhi Tongjian records that Shi Siming came out with all his picked cavalry, and another account puts the picked horse at about fifty thousand; when Shi Siming surrendered to the Tang he claimed for himself thirteen prefectures and eighty thousand men, a figure that comes from the enemy's own account and need not match the number actually present. On the Tang side Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi commanded the troops of the Northern, Central and Eastern Circuits, with the imperial guards and the surrendered contingents, and the totals in the histories differ widely, some saying upwards of a hundred thousand and some only several thousand; the safer reading is that this was a coalition with a core of picked troops and a mass of auxiliaries, and that the nominal numbers cannot be converted straight into fighting power. As to results: tens of thousands counted among the slain, with the drowned and the scattered beyond reckoning, the corpses clogging the watercourse; these figures come from the historians' reports and differ in detail between works, and should be read as orders of magnitude rather than exact counts. As to distance: the main body of the Tang army came south by way of Heyang at Mengjin, some hundred-odd li from Luoyang, and the battlefield lay between several li and a dozen or so li north of the city walls, a distance on which the rebels' siege train and their cavalry movements all depended. As to wastage: the treasuries and armour inside Luoyang had been carried off by the rebels during the two years of war, so that after the Tang entered the city their arms were short and had to be drawn from Hezhong and Hedong, while the grain came by the Yellow River and the Luo. Looking forward: Shi Siming took Luoyang again in 758 with the armies of Hebei, Shi Siming was killed by his own son Shi Chaoyi in 761, and the rebellion was not completely settled until 763 - three dates that show how little the victory of this operation changed the war on its own.
cause: 起因要從755年冬天說起。安祿山以奉密詔討楊國忠為名在范陽起兵，兩年之間打下洛陽與長安，東都西京先後淪陷，天寶末年的盛世局面為之崩解。756年玄宗入蜀，太子李亨在靈武即位為肅宗，改元至德，朝廷在靈州、陝西重建，以朔方、河東兩軍為骨幹重新集結兵馬；郭子儀、李光弼先後收復太原、潞州、河中與蒲州，又在757年初收復安慶宗，切斷了叛軍由河北南下的一條通道，東都的大門才重新出現在唐軍的戰略地圖上。叛軍方面，偽燕政權在安慶緒手上已失去對河北的直接控制：史思明擁兵自重，握著范陽十三郡，唐廷遂以封官羈縻為策，一度接受其歸降，授以節度使與郡王的虛名，希望以政治手段換取洛陽的平定。但史思明的歸降本來只是緩兵之計，烏承恩擅自策反其部屬，朝廷又拒不接受宰相張鎔的警告，裂痕很快爆開。於是雙方都明白：洛陽一日不能確定歸屬，河北與關中之間的持久戰就一日不會結束，雙方都需要一場決定性的會戰來了結這筆帳。
causeEn: The cause has to be traced back to the winter of 755. An Lushan rose at Fanyang under the pretext of a secret imperial order to punish Yang Guozhong, and within two years he took Luoyang and Chang'an; the Eastern and Western Capitals fell in turn and the fabric of the late Tianbao prosperity collapsed. In 756 Xuanzong fled into Shu and his son Li Heng took the throne at Lingwu as Suzong, changed the era name to Zhide, and rebuilt the court at Lingzhou and in Shaanxi, remustering troops through the Northern and Eastern Circuits; Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi recovered Taoyuan, Luzhou, Hezhong and Puzhou in turn and early in 757 took Anqingzong as well, cutting one of the routes by which the rebels could come south from Hebei, and only then did the Eastern Capital appear again on the Tang strategic map. On the rebel side the Yan regime under An Qingxu had lost its direct hold on Hebei: Shi Siming had troops of his own and held the thirteen prefectures of Fanyang, and the court therefore tried to manage him with honours, accepting his surrender for a time and granting him the empty titles of jiedushi and prince in the hope of buying peace at Luoyang by political means. But the surrender was in truth a way of gaining time; Wu Cheng'en went beyond his instructions and tried to suborn the rebel's officers, and the court refused to heed the warnings of the chancellor Zhang Rong, and the rift opened quickly. Both sides thus understood the same thing: as long as Luoyang was undecided, the long war between Hebei and Guanzhong would not end, and each of them needed a decisive meeting engagement to settle the account.
impact: 洛陽之役的影響，首先不在戰果而在局勢：唐軍在野戰中重創叛軍主力，東都一度回到朝廷手裡，肅宗的政令重新有了腹地，名分與正統的問題得到喘息；但史思明隨即於757年底殺死朝廷派去的使者再舉兵旗，758年重新奪回洛陽，這座城得而復失，河南戰線重新拉長成僵局，本役的勝利因而被抵銷大半。其次是制度層面的後果：借外兵收復失地成為常態，回鶻精騎受邀而入、受賜繒帛馬匹而返，朝廷對外族的倚賴與防範同時加深，僕固懷恩日後的結局即是代價；而節度使因平亂而坐大兵權，范陽、平盧、成德、河朔諸鎮形同外包，藩鎮割據的格局在此後百餘年逐步成形，唐廷的中央直轄兵源與稅源被削去一大塊，這才是安史之亂真正的深層結果。第三是軍制與戰術：此役之後，唐軍野戰以步騎配合的正面會戰加斷糧圍城為常法，陌刀、長槊與盾的組合在實戰中被定型；卡面那具羅馬重步兵所代表的邏輯——以盾牆與輪替頂住衝鋒，把勝負交給兵源與補給——同樣是唐軍在洛陽城下真正的取勝之道，只是唐廷靠的是河中的漕運與朔方的補充兵源，而不是帝國的常備兵與營地。洛陽城本身在兩年戰火之後殘破不堪，宮室、府庫與文書檔案大半損毀，重建需要數年，官署與戶籍要重新整理，這座城市作為天下副都的機能，自此大不如前。
impactEn: The effect of the battle at Luoyang lay less in its results than in the situation it created: the Tang army had mauled the rebel main force in the open field, the Eastern Capital came back into the court's hands for a time, Suzong's decrees once more had a hinterland, and the question of legitimacy and orthodoxy got a moment's relief. But Shi Siming killed the court's envoy at the end of 757 and raised his banner again, and in 758 he retook Luoyang; the city was lost and retaken, the front in Henan stretched back into a stalemate, and much of the value of the victory was cancelled. Second came the institutional consequences: borrowing foreign troops to recover lost ground became a regular expedient, the picked Uyghur cavalry were invited in, paid off in silk and horses and sent home, and the court's reliance on the outsiders and its wariness of them both deepened, the fate of Pugu Huai'en being the price of it. Meanwhile the jiedushi grew in military power on the strength of the pacification; Fanyang, Pinglu, Chengde and the Hebei circuits became enclaves in all but name, and the pattern of regional militarism took shape over the century and more that followed, the court losing a large share of the troops and the revenue it could command directly. That, rather than the fate of any one city, is the deep result of the rebellion. Third came the change in military organisation and method: after this operation the Tang settled on a field engagement between foot and horse followed by a blockade and a strangle of the grain, and the pairing of the modao, the long spear and the shield was fixed in practice by what the fighting demanded. The logic represented by the Roman legionary on the card - hold the charge behind a wall of shields and reliefs, and leave the outcome to the supply of men and food - was the same logic by which the Tang won before Luoyang, except that the Tang's strength lay in the river transport of Hezhong and the drafts of the Northern Circuit rather than in the standing army and the camps of an empire. Luoyang itself, after two years of war, was ruinous: the palaces, the treasuries and the archives were largely destroyed, the rebuilding took years and the offices and registers had to be sorted out again, and the city's standing as the second capital of the realm was permanently diminished.
result: 至德二載九月，唐軍在洛陽城北擊破史思明的精騎大軍，斬首數萬級，叛軍退保洛陽城，收集散卒重整。史思明無法再以武力北向，遂遣使求和；朝廷以封歸義王、授節度使與郡王的虛名換取名義上的歸順，一度開城接管洛陽的城防、府庫與印信文書。史記對這一段記載不甚一致：有說唐軍入城屯守，叛軍殘部退往鄴城與河北；也有說史思明仍據城不出，唐軍只是進逼城北、環列堡壘，雙方在城下對峙數月，諸說並存，難以斷言。結果則是明確的：史思明在歸降半年後殺死朝廷派去的使者，再度叛唐，758年率河北兵南取洛陽，這座兩度淪陷、兩度爭奪的東都又回到他手裡；其後他殺安慶緒、自稱大燕皇帝，進攻相州，兵敗之後的混亂中於761年被自己的兒子史朝義弒殺，到763年安史之亂才完全平定。對唐廷而言，這一役的收復只換來一段喘息，未能乘勢掃平河北；對洛陽而言，它幾次易主之後已元氣大傷，直到中唐時期才重新恢復為西都樞紐的地位。回看整場戰役，它是一次野戰勝而政治未勝的典型：唐軍靠正面會戰的銳氣與糧道的支撐拿下了城北，卻沒有把河北的兵源與方鎮的權力一併解決，兩京得而復失的循環，正是安史之亂尾聲的寫照。
resultEn: In the ninth month of Zhide two the Tang army broke Shi Siming's army of picked cavalry north of Luoyang, tens of thousands were killed, and the rebels fell back on the city, gathering their scattered men and reforming. Unable to advance by force of arms, Shi Siming sent envoys to sue for peace; the court answered with the empty titles of Prince Guiyi and of jiedushi, buying a nominal submission, and for a time took over the defences, the treasuries and the seals and documents of the city. The records of this stretch are not consistent: some say the Tang entered and garrisoned the city while the rebel remnants withdrew towards Yecheng and Hebei; others say that Shi Siming still held it, that the Tang merely closed in on the north and ringed the city with stockades, and that the two faced each other below the walls for months; the accounts differ and it is hard to settle the point. The outcome was clear enough: half a year after his submission Shi Siming killed the envoy the court had sent him and rebelled again, and in 758 he marched south with the armies of Hebei and took Luoyang back, so that the Eastern Capital, twice taken and twice contested, was once more in his hands. He then killed An Qingxu, proclaimed himself emperor of Yan, and advanced on Xiangzhou; after his defeat he was killed by his own son Shi Chaoyi in 761, and the rebellion was not fully settled until 763. For the court the recovery of Luoyang bought a breathing space but no march into Hebei; for Luoyang itself, the passage from one master to another left it badly drained, and it was not until the middle of the Tang that it recovered its position as the hinge of the Western Capital. Looking back, this was a typical case of a field victory with no political victory: the Tang took the ground north of the city on the momentum of a frontal engagement and the support of their supply lines, but they did not solve the question of Hebei's manpower or the power of its regional commands, and the cycle in which the two capitals were won and lost again is the truest summary of the closing phase of the rebellion.
